items.title: Medicare Part B premiums rise due higher healthcare spending
items.description: The premiums will increase by $6.50, to $209.40 a month.

items.title: Nvidia’s stock rises as blowout numbers help ease CEO transition fears
items.description: Nvidia’s revenue growth and $130 billion quarterly forecast showed that demand for chips is still sky-high.

items.title: My husband is happily retired at 64 and thinks I should keep working. Is he being fair?
items.description: “I’m exhausted. My alarm goes off at 6 a.m., and I have a 50-minute commute.”

items.title: I’m in my 40s. Should I accept a lower pension in exchange for naming my husband or child as a beneficiary?
items.description: “If I die before my husband, he will receive a lifetime pension equal to 50%–66% of my monthly benefit.”

items.title: Costco is benefiting from ‘apocalyptic concerns’ as customers stock up on goods, analysts say
items.description: Mizuho analysts have seen an “acceleration on emergency prep sales” at the warehouse chain following the Microsoft outage and nationwide flight stoppage.

items.title: ‘It’s downright dirty’: My brother took over our ailing mother’s life and finances. What can I do?
items.description: “It is devastating when the people you should be able to trust become the very people you have to protect yourself from.”

items.title: ‘Nvidia’s turmoil has me spooked’: Has the time come to sell my stocks?
items.description: “Real estate here in Florida seems to be presenting some interesting opportunities.”

items.title: Want to earn 5% on shorter-term Treasurys again? Watch for this shift.
items.description: Don’t rule out a half-point interest-rate hike in December, BofA Global’s rates team said.

items.title: My older brother, who has no children, cut our only sister out of his will. I’ll get everything instead. Do I tell her?
items.description: “I’m torn between respecting my brother’s wishes and being fair to my sister.”

items.title: Why Salesforce’s stock led the S&P 500’s decliners amid tech jitters
items.description: A series of technology outages has investors concerned that software companies could prove “particularly vulnerable” to AI misuse, an analyst says.
